request: CI and Dependabot should be automatic parts of the explorer workflow.
decision: Document CI and Dependabot as defaults in the organization workflow guide.

why.text: The user requires these automation features rather than an absent-CI handoff.

evidence: The kit and Dutch News Explorer now contain fixture-only pinned CI and Go/Actions Dependabot schedules, with regression tests for new scaffold outputs. The organization guide is updated to state the default and require actual CI verification.

verification.scope: Documentation-only profile update; both application CI runs verified separately on GitHub.

checks.result: Kit CI 39848448582 and Dutch News CI 39848450336 both passed quality and race jobs; Dependabot Go and Actions updater jobs started in both repositories.
